en.how: The lottery closed on 30 September at 23:59. About 166,000 applied. Selected runners were emailed from 1 October and had 72 hours to pay. Unpaid places are redrawn in new waves, so you can still get an email if you applied. New organizer (Cadence) and new name from 2027 (formerly Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris). Otherwise charity (at least €420 raised plus an €85 fee), travel agencies and official resale remain.
en.price: €169 (5% discount with a French athletics licence)

Foreigners living abroad can run a non-competitive tourist event at the same time without an Italian medical certificate; the competitive race requires a RunCard and a certificate. Minimum age is 20. nb.travel: Ingen direkte. Amsterdam (KLM, 4 daglig), deretter ca. 30–40 min med tog fra Schiphol. Togtiden er ikke verifisert.

For 2026 var vinduet 9.–22. september kl. 12, og ca. 30 % fikk plass. Forhåndsregistreringen blir gratis for 2027 (gebyret på €5 fjernes). Veldedighet (KWF, minst €750 innsamlet) og reisebyråer er andre veier. Meld deg på interesselisten for varsel.

en.participants: Approx. 18,000 marathon places. Around 50,000 entered the 2026 draw (Runners.nl).
en.course: Flat and fast, approx. 40 m of elevation gain. Start by the Erasmus Bridge, finish on Coolsingel. The men's course record is 2:03:36.
en.travel: No direct flights. Amsterdam (KLM, 4 daily), then approx. 30–40 min by train from Schiphol. The train time is not verified.
en.how: The marathon uses pre-registration with a draw. The organizer says pre-registration for 2027 "opens soon", but no date had been published as of 10 October. For 2026 the window was 9–22 September at 12:00, and about 30% got a place. Pre-registration will be free for 2027 (the €5 fee is dropped). Charity (KWF, at least €750 raised) and travel agencies are other ways in. Join the interest list to be notified.
en.price: €155 in 2026 (incl. €5 fee). The 2027 price is not published.
